alternativeArrangements.displayNote: This is the distinct fourth-verse score. The default SolfaSheet only renders hymn.measures; a selector is required or use the standalone 027_verse4_preview.json.

notationConventions.barlines: Colon cells remain inside each printed bar; two one-beat pickup entries omitted from previous 027.json are now explicit. Do not use number×3 to infer global timing.
notationConventions.colon: : divides printed rhythmic cells, NOT a time signature.
notationConventions.elongations: - denotes a continued duration; blank cells and voice silence are preserved.
notationConventions.staggeredVoices: Blank voice cells appear when one part rests while another is singing.
notationConventions.symbols: Dynamics mf, p, f, pp, ff, crescendo, diminuendo, accent and rallentando are stored as annotations.
notationConventions.tempoSource: No numerical BPM is printed. The suggested 90 BPM is an editable application fallback.
